attributes.readMe:
# Person Base

## Summary
The shared base for Employee and Candidate: `name`, `email`, `phone`, `photoUrl`, and computed `initials`. Provides the avatar-row embedded view both subclasses inherit.

## Import
```ts
import { PersonBase } from './person-base';
```

## Usage
```ts
export class Employee extends PersonBase { ... }
```

## Template Usage
Embedded view renders photo (or initials fallback) + name + email.
